{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the first occurrence
trial_df_clean = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the value counts for 'site' after deduplication
print("Site value counts after deduplication:\n", trial_df_clean['site'].value_counts())

# Check the response rate by site after deduplication
response_rate_by_site_clean = trial_df_clean.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by site after deduplication:\n", response_rate_by_site_clean)"}
